purpose: Choose exactly one next research direction by separating response exposure, local ordinal boundary support, and relative-correction landing mismatch using frozen train/dev artifacts only.

diagnostic_variables.exact_response_metric_edge_seen: (question_key, answer_key, metric_id, language) occurs in locked train
diagnostic_variables.boundary_support: Within the same metric_id-language train stratum, S_k=min(count(label<=k), count(label>k)); row support is the minimum over valid adjacent boundaries k in {y-1,y}.
diagnostic_variables.supported_binary: all valid adjacent-boundary support counts are at least 20

human_ambiguity.H2: human score range is at least 2

diagnostic_variables.landing_population: label_5<=2, response_seen, supported_binary, ambiguity in H0/H1, and raw DeltaH>0

direction_gates.D_STOP_METHOD_EXPANSION: Selected when no single A/B/C gate passes; multiple simultaneous gates also mean no uniquely identified method direction.

interpretation_limits: This is a direction-selection diagnostic, not a causal root-cause experiment.
Decision thresholds are preregistered project rules, not universal constants.
No row-level identifiers, text, predictions, or probabilities may enter the public report.
